verdict.rationale: Browserbase offers a web search for agents that finds relevant websites from a single query (docs-2), and a separate fetch that turns any URL into HTML, JSON or markdown (docs-3). Together these get full page content, but only by chaining two calls, which is the links-then-fetch pattern the story wants to avoid. Missing for 10: evidence that search returns full page content in one call, documentation of the search response format, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
